title: The Harrowing
subtitle: Pandemonium Fortress · Plains of Despair · Chaos Sanctuary

questions.prompt: Pandemonium Fortress is described as the last outpost of what?
questions.explanation: Pandemonium Fortress is 'the last outpost of Heaven at the gates of Hell.'

questions.prompt: How many quests does Act IV contain?
questions.explanation: Act IV is the shortest act: Fallen Angel, Hell's Forge, and Terror's End.

questions.prompt: Who is the Act IV blacksmith at Pandemonium Fortress?
questions.explanation: Halbu sells weapons and armor at Pandemonium Fortress and repairs gear.

questions.prompt: Jamella of Pandemonium Fortress is a...
questions.explanation: Jamella is listed as Merchant, Healer, and Gambler at Pandemonium Fortress.

questions.prompt: Who gives the Hell's Forge quest in Act IV?
questions.explanation: Deckard Cain directs you to the Hellforge to destroy Mephisto's Soulstone.

questions.prompt: The Hellforge quest requires you to destroy which object?
questions.explanation: Mephisto's Soulstone, carried from the Durance of Hate, is shattered on the Hellforge anvil.

questions.prompt: Tyrael introduces himself as which kind of being?
questions.explanation: Tyrael says: 'I am the Archangel Tyrael. I came here to prevent Diablo from freeing his brother, Baal.'

questions.prompt: Players first encounter Tyrael after completing which Act II quest?
questions.explanation: Tyrael is rescued upon completing The Seven Tombs (the Duriel fight) and later reappears at Pandemonium.

questions.prompt: What mercenary service does Tyrael provide at Pandemonium Fortress?
choices: Resurrects mercenaries but does not hire
questions.explanation: Tyrael 'resurrects Mercenaries but not hire them.' Hires are done back in Acts I, II, III, V.

questions.prompt: Izual maintains notably high resistance to which element across all difficulties?
questions.explanation: Izual has 75% cold resistance at every difficulty.

questions.prompt: What rune does Izual drop on Normal difficulty?
questions.explanation: Izual drops Sol on Normal, Um on Nightmare, and Cham on Hell.

questions.prompt: On Normal difficulty, the Hellforge drops runes from which range?
questions.explanation: Normal Hellforge drops El-Amn runes; Nightmare Sol-Um; Hell Hel-Gul. Plus four gems.

questions.prompt: Besides a rune, how many gems does the Hellforge drop?
questions.explanation: Smashing the soulstone on the anvil drops 4 gems plus 1 rune at every difficulty.

questions.prompt: After Baal's defeat in Act V, what does Tyrael do for the hero?
choices: Opens a portal to exit the game world
questions.explanation: After Baal falls, Tyrael opens a portal that allows the hero to leave the ruined Worldstone Keep.

questions.prompt: Both Halbu and Jamella greet the player with the same phrase. Which is it?
choices: 'What would you ask of me, stranger?'
questions.explanation: Both NPCs greet with 'Hail to you, champion.'
